notes.title: COSMONAUT Original Soundtrack Update!
notes.notes:
The COSMONAUT Original Soundtrack is now included with each game purchase at no additional charge:

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31482134/19db05d174e4138a5dae8a4646e478a26a8a321a.jpg[/img]

01. (1:26) Menu Theme
02. (1:39) Crossing the Rubicon
03. (2:15) Prologue Ship
04. (1:02) Tetherless
05. (2:14) The Chasm's Edge
06. (1:34) Glass House
07. (2:13) Sanctuary
08. (1:29) S I M O N
09. (3:01) A Journey's End

(Approx. 17 minutes in length)

Access Instructions:
Go to steam library -> right-click "COSMONAUT" -> choose "properties" -> choose "BROWSE LOCAL FILES..." -> See sub-folder "COSMONAUT Original Soundtrack"

Enjoy!
